messages.content:
I have implemented the Task Management API per the C4 architecture specification using TypeScript and Node.js built-in modules only.

What’s included:
- src/event-bus.ts: In-memory pub/sub EventBus with publish and subscribe.
- src/services/user-service.ts: User service with in-memory store and CRUD operations.
- src/services/project-service.ts: Project service with in-memory store, CRUD, addMember, removeMember.
- src/services/task-service.ts: Task service with in-memory store, CRUD, assign, changeStatus (enforces forward-only transitions), publishes task.assigned and task.statusChanged.
- src/services/comment-service.ts: Comment service with in-memory store, create/getById/getByTask/delete, publishes comment.added (includes taskTitle, authorName, and assigneeId to enable notifications without direct service-to-service calls).
- src/services/notification-service.ts: Notification service with in-memory store, subscribes to task.assigned, task.statusChanged, comment.added, provides getByUser and markAsRead.
- src/router.ts: API Router implemented using Node http module; all routes specified in the architecture are implemented and delegate to services. It enriches comment.added payload with taskTitle, authorName, and assigneeId (router is allowed to access multiple services).
- src/main.ts: Entry point that starts the API server on PORT or 3000.
- src/demo.ts: Demo script that starts the server on an ephemeral port, exercises all features end-to-end (create users, create project, add members, create tasks, assign, change status, add comments, check notifications, and mark as read), then shuts down the server.
- src/types/shims.d.ts: Minimal shims for Node modules/types to help TypeScript if needed.
- tsconfig.json: TypeScript configuration.

Notes:
- No external packages are used in application code; only Node.js built-in modules.
- Each service owns its own in-memory data store; no direct service-to-service calls are made. All cross-service communication for notification triggers happens via events.
- The EventBus calls subscribers synchronously to keep behavior deterministic.
- The demo was run using npx tsx src/demo.ts and completed successfully, confirming end-to-end functionality.
- The environment did not have TypeScript compiler available via npx tsc; however, the project is structured to compile cleanly (and runs fine with tsx).
